tips.text: Stack Heat, Slash or Toxin procs while he is invulnerable; they all land when the collar comes off.
Bring a Specter or a squadmate so he has a mind-control target and the damage window lasts longer.
Tank with health, overguard or damage reduction, never shields, and slot Antitoxin; his Toxin ignores shields.
Bring a high-fire-rate, high-status Heat weapon plus a second weapon so ammo does not run dry.
Do not rely on direct damage in the brief collar-off window; it makes the fight impossibly slow.
Keep Magnetic status on him with your secondary to stop his shields regenerating between windows.
Unequip Dragon Keys before the fight; they tank your damage.
Skip Ember here; her damage is mostly direct, not Heat status.
Try Banshee's Silence to bug him out of his nest.
Go invisible with Loki or Ivara and use Magnetic plus Radiation to turn him on the other Infested.
Queue one key per run if you are farming alone.
Start the three components in parallel so you wait one 12-hour timer.
Expect the fight to be the only frustration; geared players kill him in seconds.
Almost everyone calls Mesa worth the boss fight.
